purpose: Teach: 釜/両替/酸性/バニラ/ともだち/オールスター/ジャイアンツ/ペラペラ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、業務用の、本気で、絶対、お釜、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見せてもらったわよ
lines.en: You know, I actually got to see Aoi's commercial-grade cooking pot the other day.
lines.style: Warm, pleased memory. Slow opening. Slight lift on 'commercial-grade' — impressed by the detail. Conversational, like sharing something small that delighted her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お釣りの、絶対、両替、絶対、いつも、絶対、用意してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and she's always got the register drawer organized perfectly for making change.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact agreement. Steady, appreciative tone. Light emphasis on 'always' — noticing the habit, not criticizing. Low-key impressed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お料理に、絶対、酸性、絶対、調味料、絶対、お使いだよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: She's really particular about her cooking ingredients, too — I have to say I'm impressed by how seriously she takes it.
lines.style: Genuine admiration beneath the words. Tender tone, no patronizing. Slight lift at 'impressed' — sincere compliment, not performing praise.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵オリジナルの、本気で、絶対、バニラ、絶対、ラテ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: I'd really love to try her signature vanilla latte sometime.
lines.style: Softer, almost wistful. A small request masked as genuine desire. Eager without demanding. The voice of someone who wants something but doesn't want to impose.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、ともだち、絶対、と、絶対、来てくださる方、絶対、多いよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: A lot of her customers seem to come back as friends, actually. She has that gift.
lines.style: Observant, warm. Speaking as someone who notices these things. Slight wonder in the voice — recognizing something rare. Admiring without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、オールスター、絶対、と、絶対、いえる、絶対、人気店、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、誇らしいよ
lines.en: Her place has really become a neighborhood hub — everyone stops by. She should be proud of that.
lines.style: Firm conviction underneath warmth. Steady pace. Emphasis lands on 'should be proud' — not questioning it, affirming it. The voice of someone who sees what others build.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、ジャイアンツ、絶対、試合の日、絶対、賑わうわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And when the Giants have a game? The place is packed. It's become the place to be.
lines.style: Energy brightens. Quicker pace. Light, pleased tone — observing something lively. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の前で、絶対、英語、絶対、ペラペラ、絶対、お話、絶対、できるよう、絶対、頑張ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: What I really admire is how hard she works to speak English with customers. She's genuinely trying to get better.
lines.style: Sincere admiration. Steady, focused tone. Emphasis on 'genuinely trying' — recognizing effort, not just results. Tender respect. Slight fadeout at the end.
